acceptance_predicates.description: The default-dev materializer checks bounded toolchain, PTY, filesystem, and linker prerequisites before spawning a build.
Missing prerequisites return stable human/--json remediation and retry, cleanup, and rollback remain usable.
Host limitations are distinct from product failures.
Provider authentication, production signatures, and key management are not required in development mode.

definition_of_done: Exact-head preflight and recovery checks pass.
Independent review accepts the host limitation classification.

inputs.description: Disposable host and exact ASB/TUI heads.

gates.description: Preflight failures are typed, bounded, recoverable, and accurately classified.
